title: macOS onboarding: two confirmed breaks on the phone path, fixed

blocks.title: Why this mattered
blocks.markdown: A fresh-machine install (mandalore) broke **twice** on the README's headline *Mobile (PWA) + push* path — right after the launch article went live. Both failures were silent. Root causes were confirmed by controlled experiment before any fix was written. **v0.2.14 shipped and is installed** — Developer ID signing, `hdeck cert`/`doctor`, and `brew services` persistence are all live, and the fix is proven end to end: a brand-new signed binary reached the phone URL with zero manual firewall commands.

risks.label: macOS Application Firewall silently drops the ad-hoc-signed binary on non-loopback interfaces
Mac App Store Tailscale is sandboxed — `tailscale cert --cert-file <path>` fails for EVERY path; SETUP.md §6 was broken
usage.providers typos were silent no-ops (requested `ollama-cloud` doesn't exist as a provider)
Persistence required hand-pasting 30 lines of plist XML carrying the author's personal label

blocks.title: The evidence
blocks.markdown:
**Firewall:** the launchd-run server answered on `127.0.0.1` but timed out on its own tailnet IP — no error, no log line (launchd services can't show the "accept incoming connections?" dialog). Control experiment: Apple-signed `/usr/bin/nc` listening on the same host answered on that IP while harness-deck didn't → per-binary filtering, proven. Follow-up experiments showed the verdict is **stateful**: after the ruleset was touched, an unallowlisted dev build passed under both terminal and launchd. Doctor therefore dials the *running server* on a non-loopback interface (the true phone path) rather than trusting a self-probe alone, and the docs say "at risk", not "always dropped".

**Tailscale:** the MAS build carries `com.apple.security.app-sandbox` — `--cert-file` fails `operation not permitted` even for `/tmp`. Only `--cert-file - --key-file -` (stdout) works on both builds; `hdeck cert` splits the PEM itself, classifying blocks by type, never order.

events.markdown: **SETUP.md hotfix** — stdout-split cert pipeline (tested verbatim) + firewall section; unblocks today's article readers on v0.2.13
**`hdeck cert`** — atomic writes, key 0600, config patched as a raw map so unknown fields survive, `--renew` no-op >30d for cron
**`hdeck doctor`** — config/providers/TLS/expiry/SAN/VAPID/port/tailscale/firewall preflight; every FAIL prints its exact fix; `--json`; exit 1 on FAIL
**GoReleaser** — `brews[].service` (verified against the formula template) + `notarize.macos` gated on `MACOS_SIGN_P12`, inert until Apple enrollment; `goreleaser check` + snapshot build verified
**Docs rewrite** — happy path is now `brew install` → `brew services start` → `doctor` → `cert` → `doctor`; hand-rolled units moved to Appendix A under a neutral label

**Released** — Developer ID cert issued (browser, Account-Holder-only step), chain assembled via `quill`, all 5 `MACOS_*` secrets uploaded, tag pushed. CI log: `signing` → `notarizing and waiting` → `notarized` for both darwin binaries, ~17s each, first try. GitHub Release + tap formula (`service do` block) live.

blocks.title: End-to-end verification, post-release, on this machine

items.markdown: `go install` builds stay ad-hoc signed forever — signing never fixes them; doctor is their fix, and Appendix A already says so.
Tailscale certs live 90 days; nothing auto-renews. Schedule `hdeck cert --renew` (no-op while >30d valid) in cron/launchd, or watch for `hdeck doctor`'s expiry warning.
`ollama-cloud` usage provider doesn't exist yet (requested during setup, doctor now names the typo instead of silently dropping it) — filed on roadmap Later.
